question: How would you design an A/B test to validate this model change in production?
idealAnswer:
Randomly split live traffic between the current model, control, and new model, treatment, at a consistent unit, e.g. per user rather than per request, to avoid inconsistent experiences

Define the primary business metric upfront, e.g. click-through rate, conversion, revenue per session, since offline metric improvements don't always translate to real business impact

Determine required sample size and test duration ahead of time using a power analysis, so the test isn't stopped too early or left running indefinitely without a decision

Watch for guardrail metrics, e.g. latency, error rate, unrelated business metrics, that shouldn't regress even if the primary metric improves

Consider a staged rollout, starting with a small percentage of traffic before scaling up, to limit risk if the new model has an unexpected negative effect

Mentions statistical significance and avoiding repeatedly peeking at results and stopping as soon as it looks significant, which inflates the false positive rate
